# v0.14.x wire contract (frozen)

These four headers are udsota v0.14.2's wire contract, copied byte for byte from the tag: the numbers that units still running a v0.14.x server answer with. client/tests/test_udsota.py checks wire.py against them, so the client keeps updating those units; never edit them. This server's own contract is the "Wire contract" block in udsota.h.
